headline: HOU @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.24 at CHC 4.21, with a projected total of 8.45. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved +1.04 runs while CHC moved -0.57, changing the projected margin by +1.61 runs. The projected total climbed +0.47, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +15.7%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Spencer Arrighetti has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alex Bregman, Nico Hoerner, Braden Shewmake, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ian Happ, Matt Shaw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
